dependencies.required_evidence: Schema-valid independently verified activation receipt binds q1 economics and canonical denominators.

dependencies.artifact: qualified q1 reversible frontend and parent
dependencies.required_evidence: Exact source-bound forward transform, inverse, parent, coder, and checkpoint-state identities.

contract.role: raw-first population identity shared by midpoint, Atlas, semantic-route, and native gates

coordinate_meaning.canonical_raw: half-open byte interval in canonical enwik9; this interval defines economic scale
coordinate_meaning.transformed_bytes: half-open interval in the exact q1 frontend output reached by causal replay from raw byte zero
coordinate_meaning.coder_bits: half-open interval of binary probability/coder decisions; it is an event ordinal, not an inferred mapping to emitted archive bits
coordinate_meaning.physical_coder_coordinate: the coder-decision ordinal before the relevant truth bit is consumed

boundary_protocol: Define the raw interval first; never define economic scope from transformed length.
Replay the frozen frontend, parent, and coder from canonical raw byte zero to the interval entry.
Hash frontend, parent, and coder entry state before any scored decision.
Record transformed and coder-decision boundaries reached by that exact replay.
Bind the raw-to-transformed coordinate trace and a fresh byte-identical repeat.
Copy the scope-specific gross threshold only from the verified q1 economics receipt using the canonical raw span.
contract.distant_scope_rule: A distant scope may score only its raw half-open interval, but the frontend, parent, coder, parser, and specialist state must be causally replayed from raw byte zero unless a separately proven exact checkpoint is bound.
contract.frontend_flush_rule: If a raw boundary falls inside a pending reversible frontend token or frame, retain the exact raw boundary as the scoring boundary and record the transformed decision interval plus frontend state that realizes it; never round the economic denominator to a convenient transformed byte.
verification: end_exclusive exceeds start_inclusive in every coordinate system
canonical raw span equals the economics scope size
coordinate traces are monotone and repeated byte-identically
entry states reproduce from raw byte zero
population, frontend, parent, coder, economics, and mapping hashes reopen

activation_requirements: q1 and its economics receipt are terminal positive.
The full-1G lease and acquisition lock are absent.
A source-bound coordinate tracer and independent verifier are frozen before any family scope is built.
Each family binds one immutable scope manifest before observing treatment results.
claim_boundary: A coordinate manifest establishes population identity and denominator correctness only.
It grants no causal-model, archive, inverse, package, transfer, or objective authority.
No fixed 40,793-byte threshold survives activation unless the q1 receipt independently recomputes that exact value.
